selection_basis: Incident decision remains materially under-covered after the intentionally narrow three-question B17 set. The registered FDMA incident guidance and material-specific MHLW SDS Sections 5 to 7 support scenario choices without restating B17's grounding check, repair preparation or gasoline-leak isolation.

pinpoint_scope: FDMA『一般取扱所における火災対策のポイント』の漏えい、着火、換気、清掃、火気管理又は設備故障の名前付き事故 subsection
一つの登録済みMHLW model SDSの Section 5『火災時の措置』、Section 6『漏出時の措置』又はSection 7『取扱い及び保管上の注意』の明示された field
source_contract.locator_rule: Every candidate must bind to one registered source/version and one exact named subsection or SDS field. It must ask for the next safe decision in a stated scenario, not merely repeat a prevention or extinguishing-agent recall item.

planned_families: spill or vapor-release priority decisions that do not duplicate gasoline-area isolation
ignition-source, ventilation or access-control decisions tied to a named official incident scenario
material-specific SDS evacuation, containment or personal-protection decisions
fire-response and post-fire decision boundaries distinct from agent-suitability recall
equipment-failure or abnormal-condition response decisions tied to a named FDMA subsection
unsafe-action rejection where the cited source directly establishes the safer alternative
anti_duplication_rule: Do not recreate B17 C001 through C003, B12 agent-selection questions, or a generic instruction that lacks a source-defined scenario boundary. Do not substitute one chemical name into an otherwise identical SDS response proposition.
